title: Secrets
description: Encrypted secrets of namespace {{namespace}}: values are write-only and every reveal is audited
noNamespace: Select a namespace to manage its secrets.

folders.title: Folders
folders.label: Secret folders
folders.truncated: Only the first 500 paths are shown in the tree.

list.emptyDescription: Store API keys, passwords and certificates encrypted, then reference them from configs as ${secret:path}.

detail.description: Metadata only; the value stays encrypted until you reveal it.

form.createDescription: The value is encrypted with a per-record data key and can only be read by nodes with access or revealed with the secret:reveal permission. Namespace: {{namespace}}.
form.editDescription: Update the metadata, or enter a new value to store it as a new version.
form.pathHint: Lowercase letters, digits, "_", ".", "/" and "-", e.g. signing/api_key.
form.valueHint: Up to 64 KiB. The console never shows it again without an audited reveal.
form.newValueHint: Leave empty to keep the current value; a new value becomes version {{version}}.
form.expiresHint: Local time. An alert fires 7 days before expiry.

path.pattern: 1–256 characters: lowercase letters, digits, "_", ".", "/" and "-", starting with a letter or digit
path.segments: The path must not contain empty, "." or ".." segments or end with "/"

value.tooLarge: The value must be at most 64 KiB

expiresAt.past: The expiry time must be in the future

reveal.title: Reveal {{path}}?
reveal.description: The plaintext value is shown for 60 seconds.
reveal.audit: This reveal is recorded in the audit log with your account, IP address, the version and the time. Only reveal values you need right now.

revealed.title: {{path}} (v{{version}})
revealed.description: Copy what you need; the value is hidden automatically.

delete.title: Delete secret?
delete.description: {{path}} and all of its versions are deleted permanently. Configs referencing it will fail to resolve on nodes.

kek.pendingHint: Run a rewrap to move them to the current KEK.
kek.allCurrent: Every record uses the current KEK.
kek.missingHint: Records wrapped with unconfigured KEKs cannot be decrypted.
kek.rewrapDescription: Re-encrypts every data key (secrets, identity payloads, proxies, notification channels) with the current KEK. Data itself is not re-encrypted.
kek.alreadyRunning: A rewrap job is already running
kek.noJob: No rewrap job has run yet
kek.confirmDescription_one: {{count}} record is re-wrapped onto KEK {{current}} in the background. The job is safe to run while the system is in use.
kek.confirmDescription_other: {{count}} records are re-wrapped onto KEK {{current}} in the background. The job is safe to run while the system is in use.
